as_told.title: George H.W. Bush had full access to the UFO file and finished off the Soviet Union

plain: Lue Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who worked on unexplained aerial reports, says that George H.W. Bush, who once ran the CIA and later became US president, was briefed on what he calls the UAP reality. UAP stands for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's term for UFOs. He says this on podcast host Jesse Michels' show, and if true it would mean the subject reached the very top of American government.
